verdict.rationale: SendGrid documents a Deliverability Insights dashboard described as an 'actionable view' of delivery performance over time. It also markets advanced analytics and offers an Event Webhook that streams email event data, which covers the analytics core with some implied guidance. However, the evidence never shows bounce/complaint/engagement breakdowns, sender-reputation scoring, or inbox-placement recommendations. The inbox-placement claim refers to SendGrid's own delivery infrastructure, not guidance given to the user. Missing for 10: explicit bounce/complaint/engagement metric documentation, sender reputation guidance, inbox placement recommendations or testing, independent hands-on corroboration of the insights dashboard.
